options.opa: Increases expression of major histocompatibility complex (CPH) molecules of class I.
options.opb: Decreases the expression of major histocompatibility complex (CPH) molecules of class I.
options.opc: Increases the expression of the major histocompatibility complex (CPH) molecules of class II.
options.opd: Decreases the expression of major histocompatibility complex (CPH) molecules of class II.
